problem: How much heat energy (in Joules) is required to raise the temperature of 450 grams of liquid water from 18°C to 68°C? (Specific heat capacity of water = 4.184 J/g°C)
Calculate the total heat energy input required to completely melt a 320-gram block of solid ice sitting at its melting point temperature of 0°C. (Latent heat of fusion = 334 J/g)
A steel railway track girder has an initial length of 25.0 meters at 0°C. Find its elongation when heated by the sun to 48°C. (Linear expansion coefficient = 1.2 x 10⁻⁵ /°C)

A 300g sample block of an unknown metal at 100°C is dropped into an insulated calorimeter containing 500g of water at 20°C. If the final equilibrium temperature is 25°C, find the specific heat of the metal sample. (c_water = 4.18 J/g°C)

A glass flask holds 3.0 liters of liquid at 20°C. Find the change in volume of the liquid when heated to 80°C, assuming a coefficient of volume expansion of 4.2 x 10⁻⁴ /°C and neglecting glass expansion.

A solid iron rod of cross-sectional area 0.0025 m² and length 0.6 meters conducts heat between two thermal reservoirs at 130°C and 30°C. Find the rate of heat flow if thermal conductivity is 80 W/m·K.

Convert a temperature reading of 113.0 degrees Fahrenheit into its exact equivalent scale value on the Celsius scale.
How much heat energy is needed to turn 65 grams of water at 100°C completely into steam gas at 100°C? (Latent heat of vaporization = 2260 J/g)

An aluminum rod and a steel rod have lengths of 45 cm and 75 cm at 20°C. If their linear expansion coefficients are 2.3 x 10⁻⁵/°C and 1.2 x 10⁻⁵/°C respectively, find the difference in their lengths at 100°C.

A 2.0 kg copper block drops from a height of 60 meters onto a insulated floor. Assuming all gravitational potential energy converted into internal heat inside the block, find its temperature rise. (Specific heat of copper = 385 J/kg·K, g = 9.8 m/s²)
How much heat energy is required to convert 20 grams of solid ice at -10°C into liquid water at 20°C? (c_ice = 2.1 J/g°C, L_fusion = 334 J/g, c_water = 4.2 J/g°C)
A clock pendulum made of brass keeps perfect time at 15°C. If the temperature rises to 35°C, find the fractional change in the pendulum's time period. (Alpha for brass = 1.9 x 10⁻⁵ /°C)

An insulated bottle contains 400g of water at 25°C. If 50g of ice at 0°C is dropped in, find the final temperature of the mixture when equilibrium is reached. (L_fusion = 334 J/g, c_water = 4.18 J/g°C)

A structural steel tire ring has an internal diameter of 99.8 cm at 20°C. To what temperature must it be heated so it can slip onto a wooden wheel cylinder of diameter 100.0 cm? (Alpha = 1.2 x 10⁻⁵ /°C)

A composite insulation layer consists of a 2.0 cm thick fiberglass sheet (k = 0.04 W/m·K) in series contact with a 1.0 cm thick wood panel (k = 0.12 W/m·K). Find the steady heat flow rate per square meter if the temperature across the composite face is 40°C.
A hot metal plate at 600 K cools down by radiating energy to a room at 300 K. Find the ratio of the net power radiated at 600 K to that radiated if the plate were at 450 K.
At what temperature do the Celsius and Fahrenheit temperature scales read the exact same numerical value?
A steam radiator boiler receives 50,000 Joules of heat per second. How many grams of water at 100°C can it vaporise into steam every minute? (L_vaporization = 2260 J/g)

A glass window pane of area 2.0 m² and thickness 5.0 mm passes heat from a warm room (22°C) to the cold outside (-3°C). Find the heat power loss via conduction. (Thermal conductivity of glass = 0.84 W/m·K)
A metal sphere of radius 5.0 cm is heated to 400 K and suspended in an enclosure at 300 K. If its emissivity is 0.60, find the net rate of heat loss via radiation.
A volume of ideal gas at 27°C expands air volume isobarically until its volume is doubled. Find the final temperature of the gas sample in degrees Celsius.

An iron wire of length 2.0 m at 20°C is stretched between two rigid pillars. If the temperature drops to -10°C, find the thermal stress developed. (Young's Modulus = 2.0 x 10¹¹ N/m², Alpha = 1.2 x 10⁻⁵ /°C)
How much heat energy is needed to warm up a 500-gram block of aluminum from 25°C to 125°C? (Specific heat capacity of aluminum = 0.90 J/g°C)

A solar panel model absorbs sunlight with an efficiency of 60%. If the solar intensity hitting the panel is 800 W/m², how many Joules of thermal energy are collected by a 3.0 m² panel over 10 minutes?

A localized thermal bar is made of two sections of equal lengths and areas, one of copper (k = 390 W/m·K) and one of steel (k = 50 W/m·K) joined in series. Find the junction temperature if the copper end is at 100°C and the steel end is at 0°C.

A liquid has a volume of 500 cm³ at 10°C. When heated to 90°C, its apparent expansion in a glass vessel is 12 cm³. If the volume expansion coefficient of glass is 2.4 x 10⁻⁵ /°C, find the true expansion coefficient of the liquid.
A filament bulb has an operating temperature of 2500 K. If the peak wavelength of its radiation spectrum follows Wien's Displacement Law (b = 2.898 x 10⁻³ m·K), compute this peak wavelength.
A 100g chunk of lead at 150°C is placed inside an insulated cup containing 100g of water at 20°C. Find the equilibrium temperature. (c_lead = 0.13 J/g°C, c_water = 4.18 J/g°C)
